One caution: Arsenal have three players in your eleven and Liverpool two; Manchester City have two. That concentration is large, and you have no way to balance it with your budget. Watch how those fixtures unfold.

Your last three weeks cost you 13 net points against the model's calls. The hit-taking pattern here (the Watkins trade costs 4 points but gains more in projection) is typical of the decisions that went the other way. If you trust the framework at all, you should play Boost and take the transfer as recommended.
